### Meaning
| infl.  | class     | meaning    |
| ------ | --------- | ---------- |
| pe ~   | *quant.*  | thousand   |
| pe ni~ | *ordinal* | thousandth |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
From the native "1-4-7" numerical system.
#### Sound
- Japanese "sen"
- Numbers always end in a nasal coda ("n")
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Actions/sen\|sen]] is already taken, so a "y" was added.
